title: THE SIGNAL
creativePremise: A signal reaches a broken track. A link closes, and the signal reaches the waiting receiver.

scenes.name: The break
scenes.action: A square travels along a track and stops at the gap.

scenes.name: The link
scenes.action: A bridge extends across the gap while the square waits.

scenes.name: The answer
scenes.action: The square crosses the bridge and the receiving circle lights up.

events.meaning: The signal stops short of the break.
